intro.desc: A collection of infos and tools for the game {gameName} by {companyName}. This fansite is currently focused on factory mechanics to help players optimize their gameplay. Data and calculations may change with future game updates.

quoteOfTheDay.title: Uncle Fred's quote of the day
quotes: You need to get out there and get a job. Anything at all. You just need a salary right now.
If you need a loan to start something, ask Larry over at Jensen Capital.
Don't get any parking tickets.
You can use your car or continue running around with the hand trucks.
For the time being, go to a wholesale store. Down the road, you'll do better by importing directly.
Open up and start handling some cash.
Don't forget to take that course at the Business Administration School.
Having an employee takes a cut out of what you're taking in, but it also gives you extra time.
Make sure you keep the floors clean. You don't want customers walking around in a dirty store.
If customers are looking for something to drink, stock a fridge with cans of soda.
Continue listening to your customers and keep improving.
You don't build an entire empire with just a gift shop.
Don't rush into something willy-nilly. You have to know what people want.
Use the MarketInsider app to see what people are looking for.
In business, always research the market before you go into it.
Before you start your next business, find a building with a high traffic index.
High demand products and lots of foot traffic mean high revenue.
Find yourself a nicer apartment and buy yourself some really nice furniture.
Drive-in wholesale stores sell stuff in big chunks, but a lot cheaper.
Make sure to keep popularity high for all your businesses.
Sometimes you might have to increase your marketing budget to gain the same results.
The market changes every day.
Cut out the middleman and start importing products yourself.
Hire a Purchasing Agent to help secure import contracts.
Use a warehouse to store your products until you can get them into your stores.
Get your products out of the warehouse and into your stores.
Office-based businesses are similar to retail businesses, but demand depends on the neighborhood.
If employees keep calling in sick, hire an HR Manager.
HR Managers are like buying yourself more hours every day.
Having all that money in the bank might feel good, but it is not that smart.
Put your money into an investment fund.
Investment funds make money work for you, just like your employees.
Take care of yourself. Life is not all about the accumulation of cash.
Focus a bit on your happiness.
Sometimes things go up, sometimes they go down. Spread out your business.
Spreading the risk makes your empire less vulnerable to market changes.
The same goes for your investments. Start investing in real estate.
Making money does not make you happy. Life is about having a goal and enjoying the journey.
A higher level purchasing agent will ensure better import prices.
Use marketing to increase your promotion score.
Observe what your customers are saying while visiting your store.
Make sure to fulfill your employees' demands.
Unhappy employees perform below their skill level.
Storage shelves are a great way to better organize your store's inventory.
Employees need a cleaning station to clean a store.
Sleeping in your car is convenient, but it negatively impacts your happiness.
Benches around the city can be used to quickly skip time and gain some energy.
Tired of paying rent? Save up and buy the building instead.
Use BizMan's Customers Over Time to learn when your business is most profitable.

cta.title: Let's get started!
cta.desc: Just want to look something up and do some number crunching? Hell yeah, math! Head over to the {database} and start exploring.
cta.desc2: From planning your first factory to managing production rates of your whole empire, you'll find everything in the <link>{toolsSection}</link> section.
cta.errorDesc: Found an error or missing information? Or do you have suggestions to improve the site? Feel free to <contact>reach out</contact>!

intro.desc: Explore detailed game data across products, machines, vehicles, and more. Use search and category filters to quickly find what you need.

products.caption:
All products at a glance. Switch between manufacturing and import prices. Retail price is the average across all districts. Profits are shown as net values, including ingredient costs, worker salaries, and taxes based on the selected difficulty.

Curious how it's calculated? Check out the {toolsSection} section.

ingredients.caption: Overview of all raw ingredients including their properties. Select the difficulty to see the correct prices.

machines.caption: All machines used in production. Combine one primary machine with one or two secondary machines to form a workstation.

inventory.caption: An overview of all... storage options. For now. More to come!

vehicles.caption: Looking for maximum cargo or just the fastest ride? You'll find it here. Driver skill refers to your {deliveryDriver}, and max destinations require a {logisticsManager} at 100% skill.

intro.desc: This is where you can dive deep into the numbers and statistics of the game. Plan your factories and manage the logistics for your whole empire!

plannerOverview.title: Big Ambitions Factory Planner and Production Tools
plannerOverview.desc: Use the Big Ambitions factory planner to map out production lines, staffing, and supply chains in one place. Calculate required ingredients, machines, workers, and delivery volumes before bottlenecks appear.

playthroughs.desc: Below, you can create and manage your playthroughs. A playthrough represents a single run of the game. You can create multiple playthroughs to compare different runs, experiment with other difficulties, or just keep track of your progress.
playthroughs.warning: Important: Your progress is stored in your browser. If you clear your browser data or use private/incognito mode, it may be lost.
playthroughs.noPlaythroughs: No playthroughs yet. Create one to get started!

notFound.title: Playthrough not found
notFound.desc: This playthrough doesn't exist or has been deleted.

gameVersionNotice.title: Versioned Game Data
gameVersionNotice.desc: Playthroughs now use versioned game data. You can edit the game version for each playthrough in the <link>overview</link>.

playthroughDetail.desc: This is where you can see the production stats of your empire. Visit the factories page to see an overview of your factories, keep track of items you need to order for your production lines and more. The factory planner will show you all details about production stats, order amounts, and more.
playthroughDetail.noProductionData: No data available yet. Create factories and you'll see your production stats here.

factories.title: Your factories
factories.desc: An overview of your factories. You can edit or delete them and also copy the current values for a new factory. To see more details about each factory including a shopping list, just click their respective card.
factories.desc1: You can also group them together by clicking the Create Group button below. This will allow you to see those factories in one place and manage them as a group. Helpful if you use a central warehouse to provide ingredients for multiple factories. Based on the number of pallet shelves you've added, it will suggest a delivery plan for each factory.
factories.noFactories: There are no factories in your playthrough. Create one to get started!

notFound.title: Factory not found
notFound.desc: This factory doesn't exist or has been deleted.

shoppingList.title: Shopping list
shoppingList.desc: This is what your factory needs weekly to run at full capacity.

splitShoppingList.title: Split shopping list
splitShoppingList.desc: Order these ingredients to your factory to split the order. This is the maximum amount your {shelfAmount} pallet shelves can hold. It also accounts for the number of boxes you are producing. You would need {requiredAmount} shelves to store all ingredients for a whole week of production.
splitShoppingList.desc1: The rest must be ordered to a warehouse by one or more separate purchasing agents. Go back to the <link>factory overview</link> and create a group to see a full list of what to order to that warehouse. It will also show you the delivery plan to each factory.

playthroughForm.title: Create a new playthrough
playthroughForm.desc: Enter a name for your playthrough and select the difficulty so the tools can calculate the correct prices. You can edit or delete your playthroughs at any time.
playthroughForm.deleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this playthrough? This action can't be undone.

factoryForm.deleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this factory? This action cannot be undone.

factoryGroups.title: Factory groups
factoryGroups.desc: You can group factories together for a better overview per product category. If the grouped factories do not have enough pallet shelves assigned, the shopping list will tell you what you need to order to each factory and also to the warehouse to supply the rest. The deliveries dialog will also show you what to send to each factory.
factoryGroups.groupEmpty: No factories in this group. Drag a factory card here to add it.
factoryGroups.ungroupedEmpty: No ungrouped factories. Drag a factory card here or add a new factory.

deliveries.title: Delivery Plan
deliveries.descNeeded: Delivery plans for each factory in this group. You will need {amount} pallet shelves to supply all factories.
deliveries.descEnough: All factories have enough shelves to hold all needed ingredients.

shoppingList.title: Group shopping list
shoppingList.desc:
These are all ingredients needed to supply factories that don't have enough pallet shelves inside this group. It calculates based on the amount of shelves available in the factories so you can order the rest to a separate warehouse.

Shelves needed in warehouse: {amount}

factoryPlanner.title: Factory Planner
factoryPlanner.desc: Calculate the required ingredients, machines, and workers for your production lines. Just select the products you want to produce and the planner will do the rest.

information.name: Factory name
information.palletDesc: Define how many pallet shelves are available in this factory.
information.shelfExplanation: Add at least one workstation to see the required number of pallet shelves.
information.enoughDaily: Enough for daily delivery only. A warehouse is required for weekly logistics.
information.notEnough: Not enough storage even for daily delivery.
information.overflowDesc: Production outpaces ingredient consumption. Shelf count adjusted accordingly.
information.limitedWeeklyAmount: With production limits, weekly delivery requires {count} {object}.

employees.desc: Enter the salary for each employee. Leave it empty if you don't want to include salary calculations.
employees.optimalTooltip: Automatically calculate the optimal number of workers based on workstations and opening hours. Will add a small buffer for smooth auto-schedule in game.

workstations.productionLimitTooltip: Limits the weekly production of this product in the factory to the selected amount.

factoryPlanner.estimatedSalesTooltip: Enter the expected sales for each product in your shops.
factoryPlanner.priceIndexDesc: Select the current ingame price index for this product to calculate the correct income. (Export price is more accurate.)
